user.title: EG.D Distribuce – Sign in
user.description:
Enter your credentials from the {portal_url} portal
→ {path}

data_description.client_id: Client ID generated in the Distribuce24 portal
data_description.client_secret: Client Secret generated in the Distribuce24 portal
data_description.ean: EAN number of your metering point (18 digits) – meter type is detected automatically
data_description.test_mode: Enable to use test.distribuce24.cz (requires test credentials)
data_description.history_from: Optional. Empty = last 30 days. Can also be changed later in the integration Options.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid Client ID or Client Secret
error.invalid_ean: EAN not found – verify the number or link the API account to the metering point in the Distribuce24 portal
error.unsupported_meter: Meter type C4 is not supported – EGD API provides data only for types A, B and C1
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the EG.D API

abort.already_configured: This metering point (EAN) is already configured

init.title: EG.D Distribuce settings
init.description: Choose what to edit. Changes are saved only when you pick “Save and close”.

data_description.update_hour: Data is downloaded on the first tick at or after this hour. EGD data is usually available from the afternoon (recommended: 17).
data_description.history_from: History is downloaded from this date. Empty = last 30 days. If the date predates your data authorization, the range is narrowed automatically.

hdo.title: HDO tariff
hdo.description: The tariff is not part of the metering API; it comes from the public HDO schedule. Find your code on the HDO receiver by the meter or in the Distribuce24 app.

data_description.hdo_mode: none = single tariff, smart = code like Cd2526_2, classic = postal code + A/B/DP command code
data_description.hdo_psc: Only for classic mode – determines the distribution region
data_description.hdo_refresh_days: How often to re-download the HDO calendar. Seasonal changes work from memory without a refresh – this is for when the distributor changes the actual times. Default 7 days.
data_description.tariff_entity: A sensor reporting the current tariff straight from the meter (register 0.0.96.14.0.255 on the XT211). More reliable than the calendar because it reports the real state – the integration uses it for live sensors and also to verify your HDO code. Accepts VT/NT, T2/T3 and 2/3; anything else is logged and the calendar is used.

hdo_varianta.title: Schedule selection
hdo_varianta.description: Several schedules match your code (e.g. separate relays for heating and hot water). Pick the one that controls your tariff – the hours per day are shown to help.

ceny.title: Price periods

cena_pridat.title: Add price period
cena_pridat.description: Enter the final price per kWh including distribution, fees and taxes.

data_description.valid_from: A period with the same date is overwritten.
data_description.price_vt: For a single tariff, put your only price here.
data_description.price_nt: Leave empty for a single tariff – the high tariff price is used.
data_description.monthly_fee: Counted into the monthly cost sensor, not into the Energy Dashboard.

vyuctovani.title: Billing
vyuctovani.description:
Enter the date of your last invoice and the integration will track what has accrued since – an estimate of the next bill.

The advance payment schedule is entered separately under Advance payments.

This is an estimate, not an invoice: it excludes later corrections from your supplier and EG.D data arrives one day late.

data_description.billing_date: The date on the invoice from which the new period starts. Empty = the sensor is not created.

zalohy.title: Advance payments
zalohy.description:
Enter only the points where the amount changes – same as with prices. The day of month is taken from the date you enter and stays valid until another entry changes it.

You can find the schedule on your invoice.

Currently set:
{rozpis}

zaloha_pridat.title: Add advance payment change
zaloha_pridat.description: Date of the first payment at the new amount. Its day of month is reused for the following months.

data_description.valid_from: E.g. 2025-01-10 means payments on the 10th of each month. An entry with the same date is overwritten.
data_description.amount: Amount including VAT, as shown on the invoice.

error.hdo_not_found: No HDO schedule matches this code. Verify it at hdo.distribuce24.cz/casy.
error.hdo_error: Could not load the HDO schedule – check the values you entered and your connection.
